reports.title: HELMERICH & PAYNE, INC. ANNOUNCES FISCAL FOURTH QUARTER AND FISCAL 2026 RESULTS

desk.headline: Revenue up 8% to $1.09bn and adjusted EPS of $0.36 beat; $610m Saudi rig write-down means a $4.91 loss; first fiscal 2027 ranges set

other.label: GAAP EPS
other.change: vs -$0.58 a year ago; includes -$5.20 from impairments

results: Revenue rose 8% from a year ago (6% from last quarter) to $1.09bn; adjusted EPS of $0.36 beat the $0.23 estimate.
A $610m non-cash write-down, mostly on 30 conventional rigs in Saudi Arabia, turned the quarter into a $490m loss ($4.91 a share).
All three divisions came in at or above the top of their guided margin ranges; US rigs working rose to 151 from 142 in the June quarter.
Fiscal 2026: revenue $4.1bn, adjusted EBITDA $913m, net loss $569m; capex of $287m was within the $270–310m guide.
The $400m term loan was repaid early, the Utica Square property sale brought in about $100m after tax, and $25m went out in dividends this quarter.

guidance.summary: First numbers for fiscal 2027 (in October the company had only said margins should be stronger than 2026). It expects US rigs steady at about 150 but fewer international rigs as Saudi Arabia suspends conventional rigs, and capex rising to $320–360m.

call.source: No call coverage found (call held 19 Nov 2026, 10:00 New York time; no prepared remarks filed)

watch: How many more Saudi rigs are suspended: the company now expects about 19 working there in the December quarter and warns of further cuts.
Argentina growth as three US rigs move to the Vaca Muerta, taking the fleet there to 15.
Progress on the target of about 1x net debt to adjusted EBITDA by end-2027 with capex rising.

sources.title: Helmerich & Payne falls on weaker Middle East outlook — Investing.com, 18 Nov 2026
